RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias will appear unprofessional and harm your reputation. An all-female panel alone is not evidence of discrimination; healthcare administration and laboratory medicine frequently have high female representation. 

Department head roles prioritize leadership capability and operational management over academic credentials, where the successful candidate had demonstrated experience and specialized training. 

Instead, follow up politely on your request for feedback, framing it as an opportunity for professional development. If the response reveals procedural irregularities or overt bias, you can re-evaluate, but panel demographics alone do not justify an accusation or formal challenge.
